claude.title: Claude Code statusline hook
claude.intro: Claude Code passes rate limit data to its statusline command. This app installs a small script as that command; the script saves the data to a local file and this app reads it. No token or cookie is touched.

status.existingCommand: An existing statusline command was found. It will keep running after ours.
status.dataFileMissing: No data yet. Send one prompt in Claude Code after installing.

install.confirmBody: This writes {{script}} and sets statusLine.command in {{settings}}. A backup of the settings file is created first.

manual.title: Manual setup
manual.body: Add this to {{settings}} if you prefer to edit it yourself:

codex.title: Codex (ChatGPT plan)
codex.intro: This app reads the access token the Codex CLI keeps in auth.json and asks the Codex usage endpoint for your limits. It never refreshes or writes the token.

status.missing: auth.json not found. Run the Codex CLI and sign in.
status.noToken: auth.json has no access token. Sign in with `codex login`.
status.noAccount: Could not determine the ChatGPT account id.
